Digital Era

They remain essential for videographers maintaining vintage camcorder hardware or for those looking to record in a native digital-tape format.

Hayim Pinhas
Hand-Carved Meerschaum Pipe
Product of Turkey, Pure Block Meerschaum
A genuine block meerschaum tobacco pipe handcrafted by Hayim Pinhas in Istanbul, Turkey. Meerschaum is a rare, porous mineral found in Asia Minor, highly valued by collectors for its ability to provide a cool, dry smoke while gradually absorbing oils to develop a rich, honey-colored patina over time. This piece represents traditional Turkish craftsmanship in tobacco accessories.
Hand-carved bowl featuring an intricate floral and lattice pattern
Classic straight stem in a deep maroon finish with metal mountings
Includes original red presentation box and informational documentation from the maker
Crafted from high-quality pure block meerschaum as noted in original papers
Condition:
The pipe is in excellent condition with no visible charring or heavy use. A handwritten inventory number "136" is present inside the bowl rim. The stem is intact with no visible teeth marks or cracking. The original red box shows significant external wear, including a large surface tear on the lid and rubbing along the edges. Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces
One pipe retains the original factory label on the base identifying it as a Missouri Meerschaum original
Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience
Sizes range from approximately 5.5 to 5.75 inches in total length
Condition:
Bowls show evidence of previous use with light charring visible inside the chambers. The exterior of the corncob bowls remains structurally sound with natural variations in texture. Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description: This lot includes 5 vintage vacuum tubes from brands RCA Victor, Tung-Sol, and Zenith, all marked 'Made in U.S.A.' The tubes have glass envelopes and metal bases with 8-pin octal connectors. These tubes were commonly used in radios, amplifiers, and other electronic equipment from the mid-20th century. The tubes have not been tested.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:

description:
Rough and Polished Mineral Specimen Lot
Mixed Natural Stones
9.48 lbs
This substantial 9.48-pound collection features a diverse array of mineral specimens, ranging from raw, unrefined geodes to polished gemstones and cabochons. The lot includes a notable selection of quartz crystal clusters and points, bladed blue kyanite, and vibrant banded malachite. Ideal for collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, or as educational samples, the variety encompasses multiple geological formations and mineral species.
Mineral variety includes quartz, kyanite, malachite, amethyst, and jasper
Features rough geode pieces, polished tumbled stones, and one fossil specimen
Contains approximately 9.48 lbs of mixed material as shown in photos
Includes various textures from crystalline clusters to smooth river-worn surfaces
Condition:
Very good overall condition. The lot consists of natural stones and mineral specimens in their characteristic rough or polished states. Crystalline structures, such as the quartz points, appear largely intact with expected natural inclusions and edge wear. Polished stones show consistent surface finishes. Natural variations in color, shape, and internal fracturing are present across the collection as is typical for geological samples.

No brand or model, as these are natural geological specimens.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

The items are from the same selling Goodwill.

Any fragile or breakable items

Thank you for your support of our mission!

Title
:   Rock Mineral Fossil Collection Lot w. Assorted Geodes Polished Stones Shells Mixed Specimens Educational
Optional title
: Natural Stone & Crystal Collection: Geodes, Tumbled Gems
Department
: Science & Education
Category
: Collectibles & Art

Description
: Explore the fascinating world of geology with this premium collection of natural stones and crystals, perfect for education, study, or display. This set includes an array of tumbled gemstones, polished fossil stones, unique geode candle holders (one amethyst), and natural minerals, each selected for its eye-catching colors, patterns, and textures. Individual items include fossil coral stones, polished river rocks, a hand-carved gemstone dodecahedron, natural seashells, and various tumbled crystal varieties such as quartz, jasper, and agate. The geode candleholders make striking decorative pieces and conversation starters. Ideal for classrooms, collectors, or home decor enthusiasts, these specimens highlight the beauty and diversity of Earth's natural treasures. Every piece in this assortment has been carefully chosen for authenticity and quality, ensuring a unique addition to your collection. Add natural charm to your learning or living space, and shop confidentlythese stones and crystals are sustainably sourced and handled with care.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.
Items have been tested for power, not function. In some instances we may not have the necessary equipment to test certain electronics therefore all items will be auctioned off AS-IS with no refunds.
Items in lots are sold as-is, are not eligible for refunds, and may not be individually wrapped.
Please contact us before making payment to review combined shipping options.
Pick-Ups
We're open Monday - Friday, 8 am - 4 pm. We are closed on weekends and major holidays. For local pickup in Traverse City, please give us 24 hours from time of payment to prepare your order. Thank you!

{"content": {"body": "
General Shipping Policy
Availability: Shipping is available for most non-furniture items at the buyer’s expense.
Fragile & Complex Items: Fragile, large, or highly complex lots may be outsourced to a local UPS Store for packing and shipping, which typically incurs a higher cost.
Exclusions: Items explicitly marked Not Shippable cannot be shipped through standard methods
Post-Auction Process (Shipping Saint)
Once the auction closes and your initial payment clears, you will receive an email and text message from ShippingSaint to select either local pickup or shipping.
Invoicing: If you select shipping, your items will be moved to our fulfillment area. You will receive a separate, secondary invoice for shipping, handling, and materials once your package is packed and weighed. A $15.00 handling fee is charged per invoice.
Costs, Handling, & Insurance
Handling Fee: A $15.00 handling fee is charged per invoice. This fee covers the labor required to safely transport and store your winning items from the estate sale location to our fulfillment area.
Packaging & Materials: The buyer is responsible for the direct cost of all packing materials used to secure the items (including boxes, bubble wrap, paper, etc.).
Shipping Labels: The buyer is responsible for the final carrier shipping label cost, which is calculated based on the total box size and weight. We automatically opt for the most economical carrier unless otherwise requested.
Insurance: Every shipment includes coverage insured for $100 or the final lot value (whichever is higher).
CRITICAL DEADLINES & FORFEITURE
Invoice Timeline: Shipping invoices are generally issued 3–7 days after the local pickup event concludes (large sales may take slightly longer).
Payment Window: Shipping invoices must be paid within 14 days of issuance.
Non Payment Policy: On day 15, unpaid shipping invoices will result in the forfeiture of your items without a refund, and your CTBIDS bidding privileges may be suspended. Forfeited items will be disposed of at our discretion
Special Requests & Alternative Delivery
Non-Shippable Items: If you want to request shipping for a lot marked Not Shippable, you must text (813) 734-7297 before bidding to discuss potential options.
White-Glove Delivery (Large/Heavy Items): * Often more cost-effective than freight; requires no boxing or palletizing.
Includes vetted drivers, blanket-wrapped transport, and inside delivery.
Timeline: Requires a 24–48 hour notice. Expect roughly 2–3 weeks for pickup and an additional 2–3 weeks for delivery depending on the route. Providing photos of your space helps us book this faster.
Freight Shipping: Available for oversized items. Rates are determined by size, destination, urgency, and the greater of actual vs. dimensional weight.
Purchase Protection (via Seel)
Coverage Options: \"Make It Returnable\" (eligible for returns within 7 days of delivery/pickup) and \"Delivery Guarantee\" protection are available for purchase during checkout or automatically included with a Premier Membership.
Claims & Support: * File or track a claim directly at
resolve.seel.com
.
For questions regarding protection, email

description:
Artist Unknown
Profile of Man Smoking Pipe
Hand-Carved Wood Relief Plaque
13" x 9" x 1.5"
Unsigned
This expressive hand-carved wooden relief plaque depicts a man in profile smoking a long-stemmed pipe. Executed in a traditional folk art style, the piece features intricate textural details in the hair and a stylized geometric pattern along the lower shoulder edge. The warm, rich brown tones and lustrous finish enhance the sculptural depth, showcasing skilled craftsmanship and mid-century ethnographic influence.
Deep relief carving creates a significant dimensional presence for wall display
Features an integrated metal hanging loop on the reverse side
Hand-finished surface highlights the natural grain and character of the wood
Condition:
Good vintage condition with minor surface wear consistent with age. A small, stable separation is present where the pipe stem meets the base, and there are minor inventory markings in white ink on the reverse. The wood remains structurally sound with a vibrant finish.
